our_interpretation: The antecedent is the demonstrated construction of AGI, not merely an attempt or a company's announcement.
The ordinary reading of AGI is broad human-level competence, including learning and generalizing across unfamiliar tasks.
Learning from humans means using substantive insights into human cognition in development. Training on human-authored text alone does not establish that interpretation.
Need asserts necessity. Finding human-inspired features in one successful system would show their use, but would not by itself establish that they were necessary.
criteria.support_condition: Once AGI is independently demonstrated, development records and causal or theoretical evidence establish that substantive insights from the specified areas of human cognition were necessary to achieving it.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An independently demonstrated AGI has sufficiently complete development records showing it was achieved without relying on the specified insights from human cognition.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Independent demonstration of AGI, followed by sufficiently complete development evidence and a test of the claimed necessity. A verified AGI built without those insights could contradict it.
